# moshlabs_resource (Data Source)

Builds a consistently-delimited resource name from a context (account/environment/service), matching modules/system-resource's naming convention: {account?}-{environment?}-{service?}-{name}, where how much of the hierarchy is included is controlled by root_scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "moshlabs_context" "this" {
  account     = "acme"
  environment = "prod"
  service     = "api"
  metadata = {
    ecosystem = "production"
    platform  = "core"
  }
}

# Default root_scope ("environment") => "prod-api-db"
data "moshlabs_resource" "db" {
  context = data.moshlabs_context.this
  name    = "db"
}

# root_scope "account" includes the account too => "acme-prod-api-cache"
data "moshlabs_resource" "cache" {
  context    = data.moshlabs_context.this
  name       = "cache"
  root_scope = "account"
}

output "db_name" {
  value = data.moshlabs_resource.db.result
}

output "cache_name" {
  value = data.moshlabs_resource.cache.result
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `context` (Attributes) Typically the whole output of a moshlabs_context data source (or its `init`-shaped equivalent). Only account/environment/service are used. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--context))
- `delimiter` (String) Separator joining the scope prefix and name. Defaults to "-".
- `name` (String) The resource-specific part of the name. Dots and underscores are replaced with dashes. Optional as long as scoped is not false.
- `root_scope` (String) How much of the hierarchy to include in the prefix: "account" includes account+environment+service, "environment" (default) includes environment+service, "service" includes only service.
- `scoped` (Boolean) Whether to prepend the account/environment/service prefix. Defaults to true. Must be false only if name is set.

### Read-Only

- `result` (String) The computed name.

<a id="nestedatt--context"></a>
### Nested Schema for `context`

Optional:

- `account` (String)
- `environment` (String)
- `metadata` (Map of String)
- `service` (String)
